meta.title: Many pinned items
meta.description: Six items of a pinning level in the shift that has passed, and what the pinned strip does with them.

scenario: Six critical items in the shift that has passed, six routine ones in the shift running now. critical is the one level of the classic scale that pins, so this is the fixture that shows a pinned strip under load rather than with a single chip in it.
look: Scroll the schedule: the critical items that leave the top of the scroller pin, in the order they left it.
The routine items never pin, however far you scroll. Pinning is a property of the level, not of the item.
The strip is one line. When the chips outgrow it, it scrolls sideways, with a fade at each edge to say so, and the number pinned is announced quietly as it changes.
A pinned item is still in its place in the schedule; the chip is a second view of it, not a move.
